definitions.full: H3290. Yaaqob יַּעֲקב 344 , יַעֲקוֺב 5 proper name, masculine and of a people Jacob , Ιακωβ , son of Isaac and Rebekah, father of tribes of Israel (explanation from עָקֵב heel Gen 25:26 ; Hosea 12:4 ; i.e. supplanter ; compare with עָקַב overreach Gen 27:36 ; one closely following according to Lag BN 127 ; connection with Palestinian city (?) called in Egyptian Y±kb'ara (i.e. יַעֲקֹבאֵֿל ) is obscure; compare Mey ZAW vi.1 ff. WMM As.u.Eur.162 ff. Jen ZA x (1895-6), 347 ff.; see also Babylonian proper name, masculine Ya±‡ubilu , Pinches in Hom AHT 61, 96, 112 ; hence OT יַעֲקֹב perhaps originally יעקבקל or the like. compare Palmyrene proper name עתעקב בלעקב, ); — יַעֲקוֺב Jer 30:18 3 t. Jeremiah Lev 26:42 ; יַעֲקֹב 215t. Hexateuch (chiefly J E; 180 t. Genesis, once Leviticus, etc.), 34 t. Psalms, 42 t. Isaiah (27 t. 40-66), etc.; — 1 as proper name, masculine Gen 25:26 205t. (+ יִצְחָק אַבְרָהָם, 19t.); also יַע ׳בֵּית of people (see בַּיִת 5d ( γ )), יַע ׳בְּנֵי (see בֵּן 1j ( β )), יַע ׳זֶרַע (see זֶרַע 4f ), יַע ׳עֵין (see עַיִן ), etc. 2 as proper name, of a people (c. 100 t.; poetry and prophets) Num 24:5 , 19 ; Deut 32:9 ; Psa 44:5 ; Isa 10:21 ; 17:4 ; Jer 10:25 ; 30:7 +; || יִשְׂרָאֵל Num 23:7 ; Deut 33:10 ; Isa 14:1 ; Psa 14:7 + approximately 35 t.; specifically of Northern Israel Amos 7:2 , 5 ; Hosea 12:13 (+ 10:11 ; 12:3 probably, see Now), Micah 1:5 (twice in verse); Isa 9:7 ; of Judah Micah 3:1 , 8 ; Obadiah 10; Isa 65:9 ; Mal 2:12 + al. post-exilic; יַע ׳גְּאוֺן see גָּאוֺן ; יַע ׳אֵל Psa 146:5 , יַע ׳אֱלוֺהַּ 114:7 ; יַע ׳אֱלֹהֵי 2Sam 23:1 ; Isa 2:3 = Micah 4:2 9 t.
